review.description: Follow-up messages still establish durable acceptance separately from eventual agent delivery, and no uncertain message is automatically replayed. Conversation selection and drafts retain the same session ownership.
review.implementation: Inspected unchanged send_message operation state and Agent transcript paging driven by run invalidations, with error-only retry and retained page cursors. Mutation acknowledgement no longer waits for a broad refresh.
review.tests: The queued-message/uncertain-delivery fixture now emits a corresponding journal publication. Existing expected-turn, same-session continuation, transcript recovery and draft preservation assertions remain required.
